被贬废丹房，我偷偷无敌了最新章节_第11章 送财童子第1页_被贬废丹房，我偷偷无敌了一朵青莲_热点小说网
> 第11章 送财童子（第1页）
李怀安看见陈长生那张笑脸不由浑身一个激灵，顿时感觉到脸有些火辣辣的疼。
陈长生似笑非笑，“怎么，你刚刚不是在喊我出来么，怎么现在又不让我出来了，你到底几个意思啊！”
“哥几个，和他拼了！”李怀安一咬牙，三人齐齐朝陈长生扑了过来。
“看来你们中毒还是太浅了！”陈长生身体一晃再次消失不见，现在他控制着这个大阵，想躲起来就躲起来，简直是如鱼得水。
就在这时，又一枚毒丹在李怀安面前爆开。
这一下李怀安彻底被毒气笼罩，脸色黑青，现在他们几个的避毒符彻底失效，每个人体内都吸收了不少毒素。
陈长生笑眯眯的走了出来，“现在老实了？”
他走到李怀安面前，从他手中接过大印一样的法宝，打量一番满意道：“不错不错，这个大印居然是灵器，感谢你给我送宝，我就不客气了！”
“还有你们，两把法器，我也笑纳了！”
“好了，看在你们给我送宝的份上我就不打你们了，你们滚吧！”陈长生一下得到三件宝物顿时大喜，现在总算不是手无寸铁了。
上次送的储物戒指和炼制飞剑的材料，今日又送来一件灵器和两件法器。
一阵斗转星移，三人被一股大力直接给挪移出了废丹房，跌了个鼻青脸肿。
李怀安哀嚎一声，“陈长生，我草你祖宗八代！”
这次的宝物是他千辛万苦弄来的，没想到又便宜了陈长生那个废物。
到现在他都没弄明白，到底问题出在什么地方。
那陈长生明明没有丝毫修为，自己居然次次都要吃大亏。
“你们说到底是为了什么，我们怎么这么倒霉！”
另外两人互相对视一眼，“李哥，这废丹房里恐怕有鬼，咱们下次不去废丹房了，我们就守在外面，不信那个陈长生不出来。”

“不错，只要陈长生敢出来，就死定了！”
李怀安眼睛一亮，“对对对，废丹房里不对劲，咱们以后就不进去了。从今天开始，你们两个轮流守着废丹房，只要陈长生小畜生一出来，立即通知我。”
“呃……当务之急是要先驱毒才行。”
陈长生不理外面的李怀安三人，此刻他正在炼化那件灵器和两把法器。
法器在修仙界是最低等级的法宝，可以把灵气输入激发剑芒刀芒等。
而灵器就比较厉害了，可大可小，可以有诸多变化。
这个大印叫做覆地印，可以祭出来杀敌。
而那两把法器，一个是刀，一把是剑。
现在有了这三件法宝，陈长生也终于算是有了兵器。
“好了，现在是炼制飞剑的时候了。”
陈长生把废丹房锁好，又把丹老的大阵打出，开始着手准备炼制飞剑，只要飞剑一成，他就可以出去见识一下外面的世界了。

After being demoted to the alchemy room, I secretly became invincible. The latest chapter_Chapter 11 The Boy Giving Money Page 1_After being demoted to the alchemy room, I secretly became invincible to a green lotus_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 11 The Boy Giving Money (Page 1)
Li Huaian couldn't help but tremble all over when he saw Chen Changsheng's smiling face, and suddenly felt some burning pain on his face.
Chen Changsheng half-smiled, "Why, weren't you calling me out just now? Why aren't you letting me out now? What do you mean?"
"Brothers, fight him!" Li Huaian gritted his teeth, and the three of them rushed towards Chen Changsheng.
"It seems that your poisoning is still too shallow!" Chen Changsheng's body disappeared again in a flash. Now he controls this large formation and can hide whenever he wants. He is as comfortable as a fish in water.
At this moment, another poison pill exploded in front of Li Huaian.
At this time, Li Huaian was completely enveloped in poisonous gas, and his face turned black and blue. Now their poison-avoiding charms were completely ineffective, and everyone had absorbed a lot of toxins in their bodies.
Chen Changsheng walked out with a smile, "Are you honest now?"
He walked up to Li Huaian, took the magic weapon like a big seal from his hand, looked at it and said with satisfaction: "Yes, yes, this big seal is actually a spiritual weapon. Thank you for giving me the treasure, I'm welcome!"
"And you, two magic weapons, I'll accept them too!"
"Okay, for the sake of bringing me treasures, I won't hit you. You go away!" Chen Changsheng was overjoyed when he got three treasures at once. Now he was finally no longer defenseless.
The storage ring and materials for refining the flying sword were sent last time, and today I received a spiritual weapon and two magic weapons.
Suddenly, the three of them were moved out of the useless alchemy room by a strong force, and their noses were bruised and their faces were swollen.
Li Huaian wailed, "Chen Changsheng, I will blame your ancestors for eight generations!"
He had worked so hard to get the treasure this time, but he didn't expect that he would get the better of that good-for-nothing Chen Changsheng.
Until now, he still hasn't figured out what the problem is.
Chen Changsheng clearly had no cultivation at all, yet he suffered huge losses every time.
"What are you talking about, why are we so unlucky!"
The other two people looked at each other and said, "Brother Li, I'm afraid there's a ghost in this useless alchemy room. We won't go to the useless alchemy room next time. We'll just stay outside. If you don't believe that Chen Changsheng won't come out."
"Yes, as long as Chen Changsheng dares to come out, he will be dead!"
Li Huaian's eyes lit up, "Yes, yes, there is something wrong in the Wasted Pill Room. We will not go in from now on. From today on, you two will take turns guarding the Wasted Pill Room. As soon as the little beast Chen Changsheng comes out, notify me immediately."
"Uh... the first priority is to remove the poison first."
Chen Changsheng ignored Li Huaian and the three people outside. At this moment, he was refining the spiritual weapon and two magical weapons.
Magical weapons are the lowest level of magic weapons in the world of immortality. They can input spiritual energy to stimulate the light of swords and swords, etc.
And spiritual weapons are more powerful, they can be big or small, and can have many changes.
This big seal is called the earth-covering seal, and it can be sacrificed to kill the enemy.
As for the two magic weapons, one is a knife and the other is a sword.
Now with these three magic weapons, Chen Changsheng finally has a weapon.
"Okay, now it's time to refine the flying sword."
Chen Changsheng locked the useless elixir room, took out the elixir master's formation, and began to prepare the flying sword. As long as the flying sword was completed, he could go out and see the outside world.
